rationale: Operating ROA minus accruals is essentially cash-based operating profitability (Ball-Gerakos-Linnainmaa-Nikolaev), so the rank product is a cosmetic re-encoding of a well-documented anomaly rather than a new interaction.

Zeroing out the accrual-financed half of the universe creates a large point mass at exactly 0 that sits above all loss-making but cash-validated firms, so the sort no longer tests the stated conditional hypothesis and the spread will be driven by an artifact of the masking convention rather than by regime-dependent profitability pricing.

A signed numerator over an absolute-value denominator is non-monotonic in the intended quality dimension — firms with negative cash ROA and clean (small) accruals receive the most extreme negative scores while messy loss-makers score near zero — so the expression contradicts the hypothesis, and 1% winsorization does not fix the small-denominator instability.

Since RANK(NEG(x)) ≈ 1 − RANK(x), this signal is (up to the oiadp/ib substitution) the exact algebraic complement of CashBackedROA_RankProduct conditional on the profitability rank, so it is a redundant sign-flipped restatement of the same known profitability-times-accruals combination rather than an independent test.

The combination of Novy-Marx gross profitability with the Sloan balance-sheet accrual is a defensible and cleanly constructed composite with industry adjustment, though both legs are individually published and the claim of economic independence is overstated because credit-financed revenue inflates gross profit directly.

Replacing the accrual level with a five-year accrual trajectory is a genuinely distinct construct that is not a relabeling of the accrual anomaly, and the sign and hypothesis are internally coherent — the main risks to monitor are coverage loss from the long history requirement and trend noise from mean-reverting accruals.
